newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon Food H1 net loss HK$75.76 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon Food H1 net loss HK$75.76 mln.

text.p: Shr (H.K. cents) 11.8 loss vs 6.2 gain (see note)
Company name Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd
NOTE - Lam Soon Food, a subsidiary of Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd, is a food processing company.

The group has decided to avail itself to the transitional provision set out in paragraph 73 of the revised Statement of Standard Accounting Practice 17 on October 23, 1995 with the effect the group's long leasehold land was not depreciated in the financial statements for the year ended 31 December, 1995. An adjustment relating to depreciation charge on long leasehold land was therefore made with the effect that the net profit for 1995 was increased from HK$36.64 million to HK$39.50 million. Comparative share earnings has been adjusted accordingly.
